capabilities.name: Cardboard Box
capabilities.audit_rationale: Transporting a block with data is more than item transport

capabilities.name: Chargepad
capabilities.audit_rationale: Charging a player/Robit through a dedicated block was not explicit in ENE-003
proposed_observables: Pad energy, items actually charged and expenditure
Home, energy, availability and subsequent behavior

capabilities.audit_rationale: Querying tags/registries through a tool is more than a generic HUD
proposed_observables: Target type, IDs/tags and displayed text
proposed_scenario_families: Dictionary on a block, item and entity
Dictionary and namespace after locale change

capabilities.name: HDPE Reinforced Elytra
capabilities.audit_rationale: Dedicated flight item distinct from MekaSuit/jetpack modules
proposed_observables: Movement, flight state, durability and damage
proposed_scenario_families: Repair, components and flight after reload

capabilities.name: Player advancements and criteria
capabilities.audit_rationale: Progression triggered by real actions requires a dedicated ledger for each module
proposed_observables: Granted advancements, criteria and client effect

capabilities.name: Commands and permissions
capabilities.audit_rationale: Commands extend beyond the radiation commands already mentioned
